meta.title: Nafess — a place to breathe
meta.description: Anonymous peer support for people living with a mental-health condition. Share under a nickname, read people who live the same thing.

crisis.title: If you're in danger right now
crisis.lead: You deserve support right now. Nafess is peer support, not an emergency service.

steps.safe: If you might act on thoughts of hurting yourself, go to the nearest hospital emergency department, or ask someone near you to take you.
steps.person: Tell one person you trust what you're feeling, even with one sentence: "I'm not okay tonight."
steps.breathe: Breathe slowly with us for one minute. It won't fix everything, but it can make the next minute easier.

crisis.numbersPending: We will list local helplines here once our partners in Algeria have verified them. We'd rather show nothing than a wrong number.

home.title: A place to breathe, with people who understand
home.lead: Share what you live with depression, anxiety, grief and more under a nickname. Read people who live the same thing. No real names, ever.

step1.title: Pick a nickname
step1.body: No real name, no phone number. Your age range and country stay private.

step2.title: Join your communities
step2.body: One community per condition, so you read people who really get it.

step3.title: Read, react, share
step3.body: Post a story, a check-in or a small win when you're ready. Or just read.

safety.title: Safety comes first
safety.body: Posts that could identify you are held for a moderator before they appear. You can report and block at any time. Help is always one tap away.

stats.note: Numbers will appear once we have real ones.

communities.lead: One community per condition. Join the ones that feel close to you; you can change them any time.

sensitivityHelp.sensitive: Hard topics. Use a veil when your story might be heavy for others.
sensitivityHelp.high: Every post is read by a moderator before it appears, to keep this space safe.

about.title: About Nafess
about.lead: Nafess means "breath". It's a place to share what you live, under a nickname, with people who understand.
about.whatBody: Peer support: people living with a condition supporting each other, with moderators keeping the space safe and therapists who sometimes reply.
about.whatNotBody: It isn't therapy, diagnosis or an emergency service. If you're in danger, use the help button at the top of every page.
about.languagesBody: Write in the language you feel in. Algerian Darija is coming.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.lead: A few simple rules so everyone can breathe here.

anon.title: Stay anonymous
anon.body: No real names, phone numbers, addresses, links or social handles, yours or anyone's. Posts with these are held and the details removed.

kind.title: Be kind
kind.body: Reply the way you'd want someone to reply to you on a bad day. No judging, no lecturing.

advice.title: Share, don't prescribe
advice.body: Say what helped you. Don't tell anyone to stop or change treatment.

veil.title: Use content notes
veil.body: If your story touches self-harm, abuse or other hard topics, add a content note.

help.title: Ask for help
help.body: If someone seems in danger, report the post. A moderator will see it.

signup.title: Join Nafess
signup.lead: Three short steps. No real name, no phone number.
signup.communitiesTitle: Which communities feel close to you?
signup.communitiesHelp: Choose at least one. You can change this later.
signup.nicknameHelp: 3 to 24 letters, numbers, dash, dot or underscore. Never your real name.

nicknameErrors.chars: Only letters, numbers, dash, dot and underscore.

signup.avatarHelp: A shape and a colour, never a photo.
signup.under18Body: We're sorry, you need to be 18 or older to join. If you're struggling, please talk to an adult you trust, and use the help page any time.
signup.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
